title: Activation Risk Bounty + Owner Scorecard
content:
Purpose:
This sheet is a lightweight, operational tracker for the pre-launch window that treats outstanding readiness gaps as "bounties" with explicit owners, scorecards, and KPI impact mapping. It blends a risk-register with a launch-oriented SLA/KPI hit estimator and a short remediation playbook.

How it works (summary):
- Any team (eng, infra, product, security, SRE) can add a bounty entry when they identify a launch blocker or degradation risk.
- Each bounty gets: a severity, an owner, a measurable KPI impact estimate, a bounty score (severity * KPI weight), and a mitigation deadline.
- Owners commit to daily micro-updates in the sheet during the final 14-day run-up.
- Ops PM (owner above) performs weekly prioritization and can escalate to the launch commander.

Columns (spreadsheet columns and what to update):
- bounty_id: unique short id (BNTY-001...)
- title: short descriptive name (10–60 chars)
- discovered_by: name/team + slack handle
- severity: low | medium | high | critical (see rubric)
- kpi_area: which KPI is affected (latency | errors | cost | adoption | accuracy | infra-util)
- kpi_estimate: quantitative estimate (e.g., +3% error rate at 100k qps)
- score: integer (severity weight * KPI weight, see rubric)
- owner: person responsible for remediation (name + role)
- mitigation_deadline: YYYY-MM-DD (hard date)
- status: open | in_progress | mitigated | deferred | blocked
- mitigation_steps: short bullet list, comma separated
- acceptance_criteria: how we verify fixed (SLO thresholds, smoke tests, canary green)
- last_update: short sentence + date
- notes: freeform (links, temporary workarounds, rollback triggers)

Scoring rubric (used to calculate "score"):
- severity weight: low=1, medium=2, high=4, critical=8
- KPI weight: latency=3, errors=4, cost=1, adoption=2, accuracy=5, infra-util=2
- score = severity_weight * KPI_weight (higher score = higher priority).
- Example: high severity (4) affecting errors (4) -> score 16.

Daily heatmap (operational guidance):
During final 14 days we produce a daily heatmap row for each bounty. The row is a compact string representing status intensity and owner confidence:
- format: BNTY-XXX | D+N | status | confidence% | blockers
- D+N: days until mitigation_deadline (e.g., D+7)
- status: green/yellow/red/amber text
- confidence%: owner reported confidence in remediation by deadline
- blockers: one-liner or "none"

Heatmap legend (for stakeholders):
- green: on-track (confidence >= 80% and no new blockers)
- yellow/amber: moderate risk (confidence 50–79% or requires cross-team help)
- red: blocker or low confidence (<50%) or newly discovered dependency

Sample entries (seeded examples to show how teams should fill rows):
1) BNTY-001
   title: multi-tenant cache cold-start
   discovered_by: Liam O'Rourke / #serving-runtime
   severity: high
   kpi_area: latency
   kpi_estimate: +150ms p95 on cold queries at 5% sample
   score: 12
   owner: Anika Patel (EngOps)
   mitigation_deadline: 2025-01-20
   status: in_progress
   mitigation_steps: add warmup job, increase cache-size, telemetry hook for misses
   acceptance_criteria: p95 restored to baseline within 95th percentile on 10min rolling window
   last_update: Warmup job prototype running, 2025-01-14
   notes: related to infra ticket INFRA-908, temp routing to fallback model in place

2) BNTY-002
   title: streaming chunk boundaries causing incosistent function calls
   discovered_by: Maya Chen / #product-hosted-api
   severity: medium
   kpi_area: accuracy
   kpi_estimate: 2% drop in structured output validation for sample prompts
   score: 10
   owner: Samir Rao (API)
   mitigation_deadline: 2025-01-24
   status: open
   mitigation_steps: tighten chunk serialisation, add unit tests for function call boundary, run regression suite
   acceptance_criteria: regression harness passes + automated smoke tests
   last_update: patch branch created, awaiting review, 2025-01-13
   notes: GitHub PR #1267, canary target assigned

3) BNTY-003
   title: dedicated capacity burst autoscale glitch
   discovered_by: Eng-SRE rotation
   severity: critical
   kpi_area: infra-util
   kpi_estimate: risk of >20% saturation on GPU pool causing 5–10s tail latency
   score: 16
   owner: Priya Nair (SRE)
   mitigation_deadline: 2025-01-18
   status: in_progress
   mitigation_steps: adjust autoscaler thresholds, add emergency spillover route to hosted tier, increase alerting granularity
   acceptance_criteria: simulated surge run shows <5% tail latency regression, alert fires for saturation >85%
   last_update: threshold change staged, simulation scheduled 2025-01-15
   notes: escalate path to Infra on-call, link to simulation plan: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/infra-surge

Weekly prioritization cadence (ops PM + launch commander):
- Monday: scoreboard refresh, escalate any score >= 12 to commander review.
- Wednesday: cross-team unblock meeting for owner-led mitigations.
- Friday: risk bakeoff and contingency planning; mark any open bounties without progress as "blocked" and document decision.

Owner commitments (what owners must do):
- Add an initial remediation plan within 48 hours of bounty creation.
- Daily short update during the final 14 days (sheet row update + short Slack post to #launch-ops).
- When status changes to mitigated, add acceptance evidence (logs, graphs, PR link, smoke test output).

Close checklist for a bounty:
- Acceptance criteria met and validated by QA/SME
- Canary or synthetic workload shows expected KPI restoration
- No rollbacks or new linked bounties created within 72 hours
- Owner updates status to "mitigated" and attaches evidence links

Notes on escalation: any bounty with score >= 12 that remains in "blocked" or "open" for longer than 48 hours must be added to the daily commander inbox and receive an assigned secondary owner from engineering leadership.

Operational templates (quick copy snippets for owners):
- Daily update snippet: "BNTY-XXX | D+N | in_progress | 70% | blocked-by: infra-config. Next step: test patch in staging by EOD."
- Evidence snippet (when mitigated): "BNTY-XXX mitigated: canary run 2025-01-18, p95 latency delta -5ms vs baseline. PR: github.com/..../PR-1267. Close reason: warmup job + config change."

Appendix: quick KPI mapping recommendations
- Latency: instrument p50/p95/p99 and token-level timers; map to user-facing SLOs and product flows for the launch cohort.
- Errors: break down by category (client, server, model-variance); quantify user-visible errors vs internal retries.
- Accuracy: attach a small eval set of 200 prompts for structured outputs and report pass-rate before/after.
- Cost: if a mitigation increases cost >5% for launch period, mark as economics review and tag finance reviewer.

Ownership notes:
- Primary operations contact: Maya Chen (Product Ops lead)
- Launch commander escalation: Caroline Voss (Head of Product Ops)
- For infra-impacting bounties, copy Eng-SRE rotation alias: eng-sre-rotation@redwood.ai

This sheet is intentionally compact and action-focused. Use the table rows to create short Jira tickets only for bounties that require more than 3 dev-days of work; otherwise keep the bounty tracked here until mitigated.
